source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative file LF, sorted over five files_sha256; report/log excluded

scope.implementation: Original finite software ledger over frozen original fake ownership/DART/interrupt sources; no native ownership-plan implementation or upstream source copying/fetching.
scope.authority: One canonical stable ledger per fake endpoint, all users serialized and cooperating through this layer. Not concurrent kernel lifetime enforcement or a security boundary against arbitrary C memory mutation/direct old-API bypass.
scope.storage: Two caller-owned lease slots and append-only32-record history, no allocation. All model/backing/policy/accessor/workspace/output objects accessible, disjoint and retained ordinary RAM.
scope.tokens: Nonzero64-bit monotonically increasing generation plus bounded slot, never a pointer/real capability. Reuse only after never-exposed retirement; old generation cannot act on new lease. Wrap refuses.
scope.ownership: Each lease privately acquires exact RID0x100/explicitSID and one vector together through frozen registry admission; never adopts an external/real owner.
scope.callback_model: Synchronous explicitly fake host callback only. No native transport/DMA callback or fake-to-real conversion. Reentry refuses BUSY with no callback. Nonreturn leaves pending/exposed/busy retained; no cancellation/nonlocal-exit-safe cleanup claimed.

intent_and_pairs.read_preflight: Read-only fake readiness/admission callbacks run under transient busy1 before any resource effect. Initial guard/admission failure restores observable state; there was no committed lease/effect yet.
intent_and_pairs.acquire: Private staged registry validation, followed by generation/ACQUIRE intent and atomic-with-respect-to-serialized-caller logical owner commit. No callback/fallible operation after commit; pair internally completed.
intent_and_pairs.private_effects: PRIVATE_MAP and PRIVATE_RETIRE append PENDING and increment private_started before existing helper/read callbacks; only actual successful internal completion increments private_complete.
intent_and_pairs.exposure: EXPOSE PENDING plus sticky exposed=1 before producer callback; all later producer/read callbacks observe it. Successful callback never clears exposure or authorizes retirement.
intent_and_pairs.records: Generation,slot,sequence,kind,phase,result; historical records never overwritten, including retired generations. Unknown callback results retained as signed32 result and UNKNOWN phase.
intent_and_pairs.failure: Any recorded failed private effect or failed/uncertain/unknown producer effect quarantines. A failed post-producer guard records UNKNOWN. Requester, vector and backing retained; retry cannot become success.
intent_and_pairs.not_an_effect: Failure during pure read preflight/admission before an intent commits returns the guard error without inventing an effect/quarantine. Initial link-down/reset refusal leaves no persistent metadata change.

retirement.admission: Current generation, active nonquarantined lease, exposed==0 and private_started==private_complete. No caller-supplied success/completion flag.
retirement.staging: Journal PRIVATE_RETIRE before callbacks; close IRQ and mapping against private copies/inactive backing. Recheck before committing either owner release. Mid-pair failure keeps BOTH live claims and original backing/source state.
retirement.healthy_commit: Only never-exposed private resources: zero mapped fake table bytes, mark handles retired, release registry claims and complete pair with no later callbacks. Caller backing not freed.
retirement.exposed_or_quarantined: No release API. Claim/backing remain retained indefinitely for this model lifetime, even after a successful fake callback or after other caller claims success.
retirement.limits: No history overwrite, generation wrap or forced cleanup on exhaustion. Capacity failure retains existing ownership.
retirement.not_claimed: No DART invalidation, MSI programming, drain acknowledgement, DMA/IRQ quiescence, force-reset, hardware safe-free or actual hardware exposure/completion.

gates.readiness: Checked fake accessor, PHY reset clear/REQ+ACK ready, RUN, linkUP/noBUSY/noL2, synthetic PCI identity, final PHY recheck.
gates.initial_down_reset: Every API refuses with zero observable ledger/registry/backing/workspace/output changes; no producer callback and zero register writes. Temporary reentry guard restored.
gates.later_failure: After initially healthy admission, private inactive scratch/recorded quarantine facts can change; requester/vector/backing retained. Caller serialization required between sampled guard and CPU commit.
gates.default_kernel: All5 APIs GATED with no callback, I/O or object/output changes. Host-compiled KERNEL is not SDK evidence.
gates.absent_paths: No GPIO152/SMC call, native mapping, DART/MSI register writer, P_PCIE_INIT or invented T8103 MSI layout.

callback_outcomes: success followed by failed guard quarantined
coverage: Actual generation reuse and stale-token refusal without reads; old history preserved
Private pairs actually begun/completed; inconsistent pair refusal
Every later fake helper/read callback inspects PENDING intent before read; producer sees sticky exposure first
Callback and read-callback reentry BUSY; no recursive effect/retirement
Failed/uncertain effect retries refused, alternate generation cannot steal RID/vector
Retirement failure after staged IRQ close retains both original owners/backing
All5 APIs initial PHY reset/notready/RUN0/link0/BUSY/L2 preserve complete observable state
History/generation limits and capacity boundary; no successful overflow cleanup
Successful fake producer cannot authorize release; no caller ACK or force API
Default/kernel zero callbacks/MMIO/state change; compile/source-shape guards
validation.mutation_rule: Baseline must compile/run first. Counted mutants compile and fail assertions; compile failure not counted.

initial_failure.cause: New test helper name collided with included frozen IRQ helper. Renamed only within the new test include via macro; predecessor unchanged. No mutant counted from failed compile.

validation.fixture: Frozen IRQ fake register backend reused with old main/helper names isolated; old main not executed. No previous receipt or old hardware survey rerun.
validation.repository_checks: Bounded new host suite only; no repository-wide, SDK, kext/KC or target readiness claim.

actual_hardware_scope: Real saved observation remains PHY_NOT_READY; no actual chip, BAR, DMA, firmware load, initialized DART or MSI routing follows from these fake tests.
stop_boundary: One source/host receipt only; no boot packet, hardware admission or fake-to-real capability.
